subject: Security

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: No server-side authentication: pipeline has no UseAuthentication/AddAuthentication and the destructive reset endpoint is explicitly [AllowAnonymous]
findings.recommendation: Register authentication (e.g. JWT bearer/OIDC via a vetted IdP), call UseAuthentication/UseAuthorization, and apply a fallback policy requiring authenticated users; allow anonymous only on healthcheck.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: No authorization on sensitive actions: anonymous POST /reset deletes data and anonymous /about?show-details=true returns configuration
findings.recommendation: Protect reset with [Authorize] using a role/policy (and disable it outside test environments); require authorization for /about show-details, keeping only /healthcheck anonymous.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: Implicit network trust: all endpoints anonymous and AllowedHosts is wildcard; no explicit verification of callers
findings.standard: OWASP Zero Trust Architecture Cheat Sheet
findings.recommendation: Verify every caller explicitly (token + scoped policies), restrict AllowedHosts to known hostnames, and use least-privilege database credentials.
